confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from web search results that aggregate Numbeo-style data: Expatica (June 2026), MyLifeElsewhere and Expat Arrivals (Oct 2025). They show cappuccino about £3.5, 0.5L draught beer about £5.3, an inexpensive meal about £15 and a mid-range meal for two about £65. I converted these to USD using an assumed GBP/USD of about 1.33, which I did not look up. Cocktail and wine were not found directly. I estimated them from the beer price: a cocktail at about 1.8x a pint and a glass of wine at about 1.2x a pint. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings, and are the least certain. Prices in July 2026 may be higher than the typical level because of seasonal demand and events. The RBA rate is the latest figure the search showed, dated 18 Nov 2026, and the page may have updated since.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Cardiff-specific aggregated price indexes, with UK regional-city norms (for example Bristol) used for accommodation.
